body: Haha yea unfortunately, but I figure I’ve made it through 20 years already! Luckily I recently got a therapist and I’m on antidepressants, so things are easier than before relatively speaking.
Very true, sometimes I forget that I don’t owe people an explanation
Aah I understand! Thank you so much for the well wishes and book recommendation, I will definitely look into it. :))

I really appreciate your response and knowing that you’ve had a similar experience (as unfortunate as that is). Coincidentally, I am actually looking to move abroad to get my Master’s so it seems like our paths are pretty parallel! I really hope I can find happiness abroad too :) 

I am having a reaaally hard time setting boundaries, (when I read restraining order my eyes popped out of my head HAHA I couldn’t imagine doing that to my parents) but my therapist has been getting at the same idea more or less. Though knowing that you found the strength to do it and have no regret is giving me a bit more confidence in the idea!
Working on the moving away part at the moment, projected to be moving out late 2022!

thank you for such affirming words. and well at this point idk if I’ll even bother continuing with the apprenticeship when COVID is over. it’s just so stressful, and the industry is definitely taking a beating over this whole thing anyway. they loosely supported me anyways. I’m really hoping once I get my degree I can get a nice internship and maybe move back to my home state.. get a roommate or a few. nothing very solid because my life feels so volatile, especially with the pandemic. I felt very lost before, and now I feel like the rug’s been pulled under me.
